Posted by Sebastian Weber on Jan 20th, 2018 // No Comments 
Penn Davis Mcfarland Inc. lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 23.3% during the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 154,104 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 46,904 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 7.4% of Penn Davis Mcfarland Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its 4th largest holding. Penn Davis Mcfarland Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $23,751,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. 
Other institutional investors also recently bought and sold shares of the company. Sanders Capital LLC lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.7% during the 3rd quarter. Sanders Capital LLC now owns 8,483,585 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,413,281,000 after buying an additional 298,786 shares during the period. Town & Country Bank & Trust CO dba First Bankers Trust CO lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.1% during the 3rd quarter. Town & Country Bank & Trust CO dba First Bankers Trust CO now owns 21,946 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,382,000 after buying an additional 657 shares during the period. Rockefeller Financial Services Inc. lifted its holdings in shares of Apple by 29.2% during the 3rd quarter. Rockefeller Financial Services Inc. now owns 39,128 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,030,000 after buying an additional 8,846 shares during the period. Fisher Asset Management LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 3.1% in the 3rd quarter. Fisher Asset Management LLC now owns 10,888,403 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,678,121,000 after purchasing an additional 329,794 shares during the period. Finally, Guild Investment Management Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 23.0% in the 3rd quarter. Guild Investment Management Inc. now owns 42,152 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $6,497,000 after purchasing an additional 7,887 shares during the period. Institutional investors own 60.19% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
A number of equities analysts recently commented on the company. Bank of America cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and raised their target price for the stock from $180.00 to $220.00 in a report on Wednesday. Zacks Investment Research raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 target price on the stock in a report on Thursday. Barclays set a $174.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a report on Thursday. Mizuho reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 target price (up from $160.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Friday. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities reaffirmed a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eleven have given a hold rating, thirty-eight have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. The stock has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $200.59. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded down $0.80 during midday trading on Friday, reaching $178.46. 31,306,224 shares of the company’s stock traded hands, compared to its average volume of 25,510,000. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. The company has a market capitalization of $916,270.00, a P/E ratio of 19.42, a P/E/G ratio of 1.46 and a beta of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $119.37 and a twelve month high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The business had revenue of $52.58 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $50.71 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $1.50 earnings per share. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.18 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.

About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
